reviews.title: Loved it, until it started glitching and losing everything.
reviews.text: Initially I really liked this planner app and was on the seven day trial to go ahead and purchase it, but then it started glitching. I had created my planner exactly as I wanted it with a nice background and added several other planner pages and even set up future planning in future years, but then it started glitching. I had even backed it up but some kind of way after I used the initial backup, the backup was completely gone for when it glitched again and I could not go back to the first backup. Also, there are times when many of the pages go completely blank. And, it’s weird when you try to use the iCloud as a backup and not just syncing. Overall, it’s the disappearing pages and horrible glitching where the pages start blurring and doubling, I really can’t explain it but it’s all messed up and unusable. This would be a top tier app if it worked properly.
